newsitem.title: UK: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Nov 7.
newsitem.headline: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Nov 7.

text.p: The following are details of events scheduled in Parliament on Thursday --
- Statement on future business at 1530 gmt.
- Motion on the Copyright and Related Rights Regulations.
- Motions on the Registration of Clubs (Northern Ireland) Order and the Licensing (Northern Ireland) Order.
- National Heritage Committee hears from Lord Wakeham, head of Press Complaints Commission, on proposed curbs on chequebook journalism. 1030 GMT
- Public Service Committee publishes the government's response to its report on ministerial accountability. 1530 GMT. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
